$comment: Executable regression contract for the bilateral_receipt purpose gate (#81, shipped in #139).
Each case is a minimal crosswalk document plus the outcome the shipped validator must produce.
An expected-FAIL case pins its DIAGNOSTIC CLASS, never a bare FAIL: a case that accepts any
error certifies a regressed gate whenever something unrelated happens to error, which was
observed under mutation on the first version of this pack.
The set of cases that must exist, and the classes they may use, are owned by the checker in
scripts/validators/check-bilateral-receipt-purpose-gate.js, not by this file, because the
trusted CI job runs the BASE copy of that checker against PR-supplied data.

scope.calibration_owner: aeoess (registry maintainer); the gate itself was contributed in #139 by kenneives and designed in #81
scope.evidence_basis: Synthetic. Every case is a minimal crosswalk document generated by the checker and graded by the shipped validator in this repository. No external system's behaviour is claimed or reproduced here, and nothing in this pack is a conformance requirement on any implementation: it pins how THIS registry's validator treats the bilateral_receipt purpose obligation.

cases.intent: An exact mapping asserts the canonical primitive is present and declares a registered purpose.
Same question, different surface, purpose declared.
The case the gate was repaired for: a real two-party receipt that emits no signed purpose is a documented divergence, not a false mapping.
A partial mapping may still declare a purpose, and the enum is still enforced on it.
An exact mapping without a purpose must not pass silently.
An honest gap carries no purpose and is correct.
The second defect the nine-case matrix surfaced: a no_mapping row asserting no receipt exists while naming a purpose for it is internally contradictory.
Whenever a purpose is supplied it must be a registered value.

Branch the pack's own prose claimed and never tested. false_analog may omit purpose on the same grounds as partial. Uses the canonical token only, never the deprecated alias, so a time-bounded migration does not become part of a permanent contract.
The shipped gate accepts purpose as a string or an array. The array path was unexercised.
Every element of an array is enum-checked, so one bad element fails the row.
